The following is required miscellaneous equipment:
(a) An approved seat for each occupant.
(b) An approved safety belt for each occupant.
(c) A master switch arrangement for electrical circuits other than ignition.
(d) An adequate source of electrical energy.
(e) Electrical protective devices.
(f) Hand fire extinguishers.
(g) A windshield wiper or equivalent device for each pilot station.
(h) A two-way radio communication system.
(i) An ignition switch for each, and for all, engines, as prescribed in Sec. 29.1145.
